rows.concept: Queryable Encryption prefix, suffix and substring query configuration
rows.rationale: No Queryable Encryption label or child exists in either inventory; generic CSFLE does not capture randomized searchable string indexes. Fresh official release confirms GA in September 2026.

rows.concept: Change-stream point-in-time images and retention lifecycle
rows.rationale: Change-stream resumability and resume-token concepts exist, but labels contain no pre/post-image retention or lookup-consistency frontier. The delta is image availability and temporal correctness rather than token handling.

rows.concept: Client-side encryption DEK rewrapping with rewrapManyDataKey
rows.rationale: KMS Key Rotation Atlas concerns managed at-rest keys; no existing label addresses client-side encrypted DEK rewrapping or the key-vault boundary.

rows.concept: Load-balanced cursor and transaction connection pinning
rows.rationale: CMAP and distributed transactions are broad existing nodes, but labels have no MongoDB load-balanced pinning frontier. This is backend affinity over a load balancer, distinct from ordinary pool sizing. Adjacent CMAP pack was absent.

rows.concept: MongoClient bulkWrite multi-namespace batching and result cursors
rows.rationale: bulk-write-ordering and Streaming Write Semantics exist, but no multi-namespace bulkWrite frontier does. The gap is cross-namespace wire batching and result reconstruction, not ordered/unordered write semantics alone.

rows.concept: Queryable Encryption ESC/ECOC metadata compaction and leakage tradeoffs
rows.rationale: Existing encryption coverage has no searchable-encryption metadata lifecycle; ordinary WiredTiger compaction is a different mechanism.

rows.concept: Replication flow-control tickets and majority-commit lag diagnosis
rows.rationale: No flow-control concept or frontier child exists. Replication Lag Monitoring and majority commit point mechanics cover symptoms/visibility, while this delta is the feedback mechanism that throttles primary writes.

rows.concept: Resharding catch-up critical section and commit boundary
rows.rationale: Reshard to the same key and zone/cost levers exist, but labels have no resharding phase or critical-section concept. The delta is correctness and application latency during cutover, not shard-key choice or redistribution economics.
rows.parentConcept: Shard Key Design and Resharding as Cost Levers

rows.concept: Sharding catalog consistency checks beyond index parity
rows.rationale: Detecting inconsistent indexes across shards exists, but no frontier covers non-index catalog consistency. This scope excludes redoing index parity and instead covers placement/catalog checks after maintenance.
rows.parentConcept: Shard Key Design and Resharding as Cost Levers

rows.concept: Tracked query memory across explain, currentOp and profiler
rows.rationale: Existing memory-limit and profiling labels do not name tracked-memory correlation.

rows.concept: Atlas Online Archive pause, expiration and deletion lifecycle boundaries
rows.rationale: Existing expiration rule covers retention configuration; missing delta is lifecycle coupling across pause, deletion and cluster removal, including the five-day object purge.

rows.concept: Atlas Stream Processing per-event vector search enrichment
rows.rationale: Vector Search packs describe retrieval for applications; no existing ASP child or queue binds per-event semantic enrichment to stream processing failure semantics.

rows.concept: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization
rows.rationale: Federation architecture label is broad; no child, alias or queue names the mapping-dependent direct proxy fast path, distinct from object-store partition pruning.

rows.concept: Atlas Online Archive sharding identity safety and orphan recovery
rows.rationale: Existing archive skill omits shard and reshard terms and incorrectly associates ORPHANED only with a missing cluster. No child or queue covers the identity hazard.

rows.concept: Atlas Stream Processing cached lookup TTL and eviction
rows.rationale: Existing ASP reference includes ordinary $lookup but no cachedLookup; no queue or child covers bounded enrichment-cache behavior.

rows.concept: Atlas Stream Processing partition idleness versus window idleness
rows.rationale: Generic watermarks are present, but existing reference contains neither idleTimeout nor partitionIdleTimeout; separate idle sources and idle partitions need distinct controls.

rows.concept: Atlas Stream Processing resumable initial sync and source retention
rows.rationale: Generic checkpoint and migration CDC labels exist; ASP reference lacks initialSync and does not describe checkpointing the source-copy phase.

rows.concept: Atlas Stream Processing throttle rate limits and backpressure
rows.rationale: No ASP throttle concept exists; general throttling or operation rejection labels address different systems.

rows.concept: MongoDB Search concurrent segment execution
rows.rationale: Existing Search reference contains no concurrent option; existing node sizing covers capacity but not explicit segment-parallel query execution.

rows.concept: MongoDB Search searchNodePreference routing and result consistency
rows.rationale: Existing Search reference has no searchNodePreference. Pagination and index-lag concepts do not cover routing affinity or its consistency limits.

rows.concept: Queryable Encryption contention and range-index tuning
rows.rationale: Neither a searchable-encryption contention mechanism nor encrypted range-index parameter coverage appears in trees, aliases, frontier children, manifests or queues.

rows.concept: Sharded routing-cache invalidation and stale-metadata diagnosis
rows.rationale: Sharded query targeting and orphan filtering already exist. No routing-cache or stale-config concept exists; this frontier explains cache freshness and safe diagnostic scope rather than index-based shard targeting.
rows.parentConcept: MongoDB Query Shape Optimization: Sort, Pagination, Operators and Sharded Targeting

rows.concept: Split change-stream event fragments and fragment-token recovery
rows.rationale: Neither split-event nor fragment concepts occur in labels. Existing resume-token coverage concerns complete events; per-fragment tokens and events exceeding BSON size introduce a separate reconstruction/recovery contract.

rows.concept: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming
rows.rationale: Neither mirrored reads nor targeted mirrored reads occurs in labels. Election timing does not describe the cache-warming work that reduces cold-cache failover latency.

rows.concept: NoWritesPerformed and retryable batch outcome ambiguity
rows.rationale: Retryable Writes is an existing leaf, and Java retry semantics/CSOT are covered elsewhere. No child isolates proof of zero writes versus ambiguous or partial batch outcomes. Existing retry pack was absent, so novelty is conservatively reduced.

rows.concept: validate full versus BSON conformance checks across upgrades
rows.rationale: Existing corruption recovery is broad and no frontier names the validation-option boundary.

rows.concept: Awaitable hello streaming monitoring and FaaS polling
rows.rationale: SDAM is an existing broad leaf with no children. The proposed frontier isolates the concrete monitoring protocol and the FaaS exception rather than repeating topology classification or server-selection timeout. Adjacent named pack was not present for fact-level confirmation.

rows.concept: Atlas Stream Processing Lambda external functions and error semantics
rows.rationale: Existing ASP reference contains no Lambda or externalFunction coverage; cloud connector labels do not describe execution and error semantics.

rows.concept: Atlas Stream Processing regional failover processor semantics
rows.rationale: No failover processor label exists. Generic MongoDB replica-set failover does not describe ASP regional execution or connector rebinding.

rows.concept: MongoDB Search synonym map update propagation and validation
rows.rationale: Existing skill describes equivalent/explicit synonym syntax, but no tree/queue mechanism covers watched synonym updates or validation failure; this scope excludes basic synonym syntax.

rows.concept: Aggregation EJSON round-tripping and BSON type preservation
rows.rationale: No EJSON or Extended JSON conversion label exists in either tree, aliases or frontier queues.

rows.concept: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries
rows.rationale: Existing settings inspection and pinning labels omit representative-query lifecycle.
rows.parentConcept: MongoDB query planner, plan cache, query settings and hints

rows.concept: BinData subtype-aware aggregation dispatch and invalid inputs
rows.rationale: Existing BinData ingestion does not expose an explicit subtype-inspection frontier.

rows.concept: currentOp versionContext for FCV transition diagnosis
rows.rationale: FCV pinning is present but the operation-context diagnostic field is not named.
